spec.title: [$cluster_name] [$fe_instance] JVM Young
spec.description:
JVM young generation usage of specified Frontend.
Left Y Axes shows the used/max young generation size.
Right Y Axes shows the used percentage.

spec.expr: sum(jvm_young_size_bytes{job="$cluster_name", instance=~"$fe_instance", type="used"}) by(instance) * 100 / sum(jvm_young_size_bytes{job="$cluster_name", instance=~"$fe_instance", type="committed"}) by(instance)

spec.title: [$cluster_name] [$fe_instance] JVM Old
spec.description:
JVM old generation usage of specified Frontend. Left Y Axes shows the used/max old generation size. Right Y Axes shows the used percentage.
Normally, the usage percentage should be less than 80%.

spec.expr: sum(jvm_old_size_bytes{job="$cluster_name", instance=~"$fe_instance", type="used"}) by(instance) * 100 / sum(jvm_old_size_bytes{job="$cluster_name", instance=~"$fe_instance", type="committed"}) by(instance)

spec.title: [$cluster_name] [$fe_instance] JVM Young GC
spec.description:
JVM young gc stat of specified Frontend. 
Left Y Axes shows times of young gc.
Right Y Axes shows the time cost of each young gc.

spec.expr: sum(jvm_young_gc{job="$cluster_name", instance=~"$fe_instance", type="time"}) by(instance) / sum(jvm_young_gc{job="$cluster_name", instance="$fe_instance", type="count"}) by(instance)

spec.title: [$cluster_name] [$fe_instance] JVM Old GC
spec.description:
JVM full gc stat of specified Frontend. 
Left Y Axes shows times of full gc.
Right Y Axes shows the time cost of each full gc.

spec.expr: sum(jvm_old_gc{job="$cluster_name", instance=~"$fe_instance", type="time"}) by(instance) / sum(jvm_old_gc{job="$cluster_name", instance="$fe_instance", type="count"}) by(instance)

spec.title: Cluster FE JVM Heap Stat
spec.description: The JVM heap usage percent of each Frontend of each StarRocks cluster.

spec.expr: sum(jvm_heap_size_bytes{group="fe", type="used"} * 100) by (instance, job) / sum(jvm_heap_size_bytes{group="fe", type="max"}) by (instance, job)

spec.title: [$cluster_name] RPS
spec.description:
Requests per seconds on each Frontends.
Requests include all requests sending to the Frontends.

spec.title: [$cluster_name] QPS
spec.description:
Queries per seconds on each Frontends.
Queries only include Select requests.

spec.title: [$cluster_name] 99th Latency
spec.description: 99 quantiles of query latency on each Frontends.

spec.title: [$cluster_name] Disk Usage
spec.description: Disk capacity usage of Backends

spec.expr: (SUM(starrocks_be_disks_total_capacity{job="$cluster_name"}) by (instance, path) - SUM(starrocks_be_disks_avail_capacity{job="$cluster_name"}) by (instance, path)) / SUM(starrocks_be_disks_total_capacity{job="$cluster_name"}) by (instance, path)
